# SAG Website: Master Checklist

Source of truth for the SAG build. Mark items DONE with the final value used.

## Discovery
- [x] DONE: Layout deck (32 slides) and News mockup (9 pages) reviewed; site plan in `docs/site-plan.md`
- [x] DONE: Images extracted to `assets/img/`; page copy extracted to `content/`
- [x] DONE: Brand colors pixel sampled (`#241AEE`, `#DEDCFC`, `#292929`, `#7F7F7F`) and contrast measured
- [ ] Canonical domain confirmed (subadvocates.org vs submarinersadvocacygroup.org)
- [ ] Current host and DNS provider identified; DNS access granted
- [ ] GitHub repo owner decided (SAG org vs geraldz-zigtech-llc then transfer)
- [ ] Unified visual theme approved (deck style vs News style)

## Build
- [x] DONE: Shared template (header, nav, footer, watermark); Jinja2 generator at `build/build.py`, output is static HTML
- [x] DONE: Home, Mission, Vision, Core Values (axe-core clean desktop and mobile; noindex while on preview URL)
- [x] DONE: About plus Our Goals
- [x] DONE: Board index plus 10 bios from `build/data/board.json` (Rodney Boucher shows crest placeholder and "coming soon" until photo and bio arrive)
- [x] DONE: Regional index plus 10 rep pages from `build/data/regional.json` (one factual line plus "full biography coming soon" until SAG sends bios; Edward Perry shows crest placeholder)
- [x] DONE: News index plus 6 articles from `build/data/news.json` (PDF buttons show "PDF coming soon" and video shows a placeholder until SAG supplies the files and YouTube URL)
- [x] DONE: Donate page with SAG copy as written; Zeffy slot shows placeholder until `zeffy_url` is set in `build/data/donate.json`
- [x] DONE: Contact form built (FormSubmit, honeypot, `_autoresponse`, absolute `_next`); renders disabled until the recipient email is set in `build/build.py`
- [x] DONE: `thank-you.html` (noindex, excluded from sitemap, Disallow in robots.txt)
- [x] DONE: `404.html` (absolute base path so styles and links work at any missing URL depth; tested at /SAG/news/does-not-exist.html)
- [x] DONE: `store.html` placeholder (noindex) until SAG names the store platform
- [x] DONE: Favicon and apple-touch-icon from crest (alpha bounding box crop)
